g.text: K2: one CTA per Q tile, online softmax over KV tiles, 4 threads per row
sKV (64, d) BF16: K_j, then V_j
S = Q K^T, P = exp(S - m), O += P V
each holds d/4 columns of O_r (FP32)
end: O_r = O_r / l_r, store BF16
Grid: (N / 64) x B CTAs, 256 threads each. N / 64 KV iterations per CTA (fewer under the causal mask: tiles above the diagonal are skipped).
The N x N score matrix never exists; only one 64 x 64 tile of it at a time.
